CITY OF SAN JOSE -- MEMORANDUM
Hugh Baker
Comments on CDBG EIR 1978-1981
FROM
Margaret Cohen
March 22, 1978
DATE
I have received the following comments from Gordon Schmelzer regarding the CDBG EIR:
The Olinder Library will be located on the SE corner of 23rd Street. Figure 9 following page 9 and page 18 should be changed to reflect this.
Mergaret Cohen
